Prescriptions at Pacific Fair, Broadbeach

Any valid Australian prescription can be filled at Priceline Pharmacy Pacific Fair in Broadbeach, with most scripts ready in minutes and no appointment needed. Bring in a paper script, show us an eScript on your phone, or send it ahead through the app so it’s waiting when you arrive. There’s no fee for dispensing or for sending your script ahead.

Reviewed by Jason Markey, owner and pharmacist · Updated 7 October 2026

Get the app to send your script Call (07) 5592 2099

At a glance

What it is
Dispensing of paper prescriptions, eScripts, hospital, private, interstate and veterinary prescriptions, with repeats kept on file.
Who it's for
Anyone with a valid Australian prescription, including visitors to the Gold Coast.
Cost
PBS and private prices apply to the medicine. No fee for dispensing or for sending your script ahead.
How long
Most scripts are ready in minutes. Send it ahead and collect when it suits you.
Booking
No appointment needed.
How to book
Send your eScript through the Priceline Pharmacy app or MedAdvisor, or bring it to the prescription counter at the back of the store.
Get the app (iPhone) Get the app (Android)

Already have the app? Choose Priceline Pharmacy Pacific Fair as your store, then send your eScript from the app.

How do I send my eScript ahead?

The easiest way to skip the wait is to send your eScript to us before you arrive, using the MedAdvisor app or the Priceline Pharmacy app:

  1. Open the app (or log in to MedAdvisor in your browser).
  2. Add your eScript: paste the token link, scan the QR code, or use Snap n Send.
  3. Choose Priceline Pharmacy Pacific Fair, Shop 81, Pacific Fair Shopping Centre, Broadbeach QLD 4218.
  4. Submit your order and we’ll let you know when it’s ready to collect.

What other ways can I fill my prescription?

Show us your eScript in store

Come to the prescription counter at the back of the store and show us the QR code in your SMS or email.

Paper scripts

Hand your script to us at the prescription counter. If you’d rather not wait, do some shopping and collect it on your way out.

Active Script List

An Active Script List keeps all your eScripts in one place, so you don’t need to keep track of individual tokens. Ask us and we can register you in store. Once you’re set up, with your consent we can find your current scripts whenever you visit.

Scripts on file

We can keep your repeat prescriptions on file, so you don’t need to bring the paperwork each time.

Hospital, private and interstate prescriptions

We dispense hospital discharge scripts and private prescriptions as well as scripts from your GP. Prescriptions from doctors in other Australian states can be filled here too, which makes us a handy stop for visitors to the Gold Coast. Visiting the Gold Coast? See our guide for visitors. Prescriptions written overseas can’t be dispensed in Australia; the GPs at Help Medical, inside our store, can help.

Veterinary prescriptions

We also dispense prescriptions written by your vet. Bring in the script and we’ll supply the medicine where it’s one we can stock or order.

Why is dispensing so fast here?

Our dispensary uses a robotic system that stores and picks medicines automatically. It finds the right medicine in seconds, which frees our pharmacists to spend more time checking your prescription and talking with you, not searching shelves.

Can you get hard-to-find medicines?

We work with several wholesalers and can order in most medicines, including specialised and less common ones. If a medicine is short nationally, we’ll let you know your options and speak to your doctor if needed. Call us on (07) 5592 2099 or email pharmacy@pricelinepf.com.au to check availability.

How do I avoid running out?

  • Priceline Pharmacy app. Order your scripts and get reminders when repeats are due.
  • Medication packing. Your medicines organised by day and time in weekly blister packs.
  • Medication reviews. A free one-on-one check if you take several medicines.

Need a new script?

The GPs at Help Medical, an independent general practice located inside our store, can see you, and you can fill the prescription a few steps away in the same visit.

Questions about your medicine?

Ask us anything: how to take it, what side effects to expect, or whether it suits your other medicines, vitamins and supplements. There’s no appointment needed; just ask at the counter or call us on (07) 5592 2099.

Common questions

Do you accept eScripts?

Yes. Show us the QR code in your SMS or email at the prescription counter, or send it ahead through the Priceline Pharmacy app or MedAdvisor and collect it when it suits you.

Can I fill a hospital prescription here?

Yes. We dispense hospital discharge scripts and private prescriptions as well as scripts from your GP. Bring it to the prescription counter at the back of the store.

Can you fill a prescription from another state?

Yes. A valid paper prescription or eScript from any Australian doctor can be filled here, so visitors to the Gold Coast are welcome. Bring your Medicare card if you have one.

Can you fill a prescription written overseas?

No. Prescriptions written outside Australia can’t be dispensed here. The GPs at Help Medical, inside our store, can see you and write an Australian prescription if appropriate, and we can fill it a few steps away.

Do you dispense veterinary prescriptions?

Yes. Bring in your pet’s script from your vet and we’ll dispense it where the medicine is one we can supply or order in.

Can you order in a medicine you don’t have?

Usually, yes. We work with several wholesalers and can source most medicines, including specialised and hard-to-find ones. Call us on (07) 5592 2099 with the details and we’ll tell you how quickly we can get it in.

Do you deliver prescriptions?

We don’t offer a regular prescription delivery service, and prescription medicines can’t be ordered through Uber Eats. In an urgent situation, call us: if a team member is available we may be able to arrange a delivery for a fee, but we can’t promise it.
